revenue.source: PepsiCo FY2025 Form 10-K/ARS consolidated statement of income (net revenue)

operating_income.source: PepsiCo FY2025 10-K consolidated statement of income (operating profit)

d_and_a.source: PepsiCo FY2025 ARS (sec.gov 000130817926000172) cash flow statement, depreciation and amortization

capex.source: PepsiCo FY2025 ARS cash flow statement, capital spending

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 growth was 2.3%; modest pricing plus volume recovery, converging to ~3% long-run staples growth

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 12.2% depressed by impairment/restructuring; FY2023-24 averaged ~13.5-14%; assume partial recovery to 13.5%

tax_rate.source: Assumption: approx US statutory 21%; PEP effective rate not verified in sources retrieved

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 4.7% (4,415/93,925); company guides capital spending below 5% of net revenue

wacc.source: Assumption: low-beta staples, ~4.3% risk-free, ~5% ERP, beta ~0.6, mix of debt; rounded 7%

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: approx long-run inflation/nominal GDP below risk-free

net_debt.source: FY2025 balance sheet (12/27/2025): short-term debt 6,861 + long-term debt 42,321 - cash 9,159 - short-term investments 371

diluted_shares.source: PepsiCo FY2025 earnings release: weighted-average diluted common shares for year ended 12/27/2025, 1,373 million
